name: Wave3 closed native evidence — exact preserved archive
body:
Private archival evidence for Maktabah / Otzaria.

The original self-contained archive and complete metadata are preserved with SHA256 and authenticated readback. Original failed and successful test evidence remains distinct. This draft is not an application release and establishes no SDK, native, production or TestFlight acceptance.
